title: DGR TO HOST EX-SERVICEMEN JOB FAIR IN GURUGRAM ON 20 NOV 26
body_text: Gurugram, Haryana – In a landmark initiative to empower and support the reintegration of Ex-Servicemen (ESM) into the civilian workforce, the Directorate General Resettlement (DGR), Department of Ex-Servicemen Welfare (MoD) is organizing a Job Fair for Ex-Servicemen on 20 November 2026 at 54 ASP, Air Force Station, Near ShaheedAtul Attari Marg, Gurugram, Haryana. The Job Fair will provide a dedicated platform for Ex-Servicemen from the Indian Army, Navy and Air Force to connect with leading employers from the corporate sector and industry across diverse fields, including security, IT, administration, logistics, healthcare and engineering. This initiative reflects the continued commitment of the Department of Ex-Servicemen Welfare (MoD), towards the resettlement and welfare of ESM. It recognises the value of their discipline, leadership, technical expertise and professional experience, which are highly relevant to the requirements of the civilian workforce. During the FY 2026–27, the Directorate General Resettlement (DGR) is conducting 18 Job Fairs for ESM at various locations across the country. The DGR Job Fairs provide a dedicated platform for Ex-Servicemen to showcase their skills, experience and professional capabilities to prospective employers, while enabling organisations to connect with a pool of disciplined, skilled and experienced professionals. Employers can register free of cost to access the resumes of registered Ex-Servicemen and identify suitable candidates for their recruitment requirements. They can also plan interviews and selection processes for shortlisted candidates during the Job Fair, facilitating meaningful engagement between employers and job-seeking veterans. Employers and Ex-Servicemen can register online on www.esmhire.com which is an AI powered job platform exclusively for Ex-Servicemen. Link for registration is also available on DGR website www.dgrindia.gov.in under Job Fair button.Registration is now open and is free for ESM and Employers. Date and Time: 20 Nov 2026, 7:00 A.M. onwards Venue: 54 ASP, Air Force Station, Near Shaheed Atul AttariMarg, Gurugram, Haryana.
